Come to the table

On selected Sundays through the year we gather for a parish potluck, and everyone is invited to contribute.

View upcoming parish events →

Bring a favourite dish, help with drinks or supplies, take a turn at setting up or clearing away — or simply come and share the meal with us. There is always room at the table.

A parish meal is one of the easiest places to bring someone: a friend who has been meaning to visit, a neighbour, a family who has just moved here. Nobody is counted at the door.
